title: JSA advises 6 SPVs of Gemstar on securing finances for smart metering projects
description: JSA Advocates & Solicitors has advised six SPVs of Gemstar Infra Pte. Ltd. for availing finances through the issuance of debentures to International Finance Corporation and credit facilities from India Infrastructure Finance Company Limited, for smart metering projects in India.The Firm advised the following SPVs:Genus Bikana Smart Metering SPV Private LimitedGenus Banas Smart Metering SPV Private LimitedGenus Shekhawati Smart Metering Solutions SPV Private LimitedGenus Mewar Smart Metering
